text: `ContainerBuilder` | Fluent builder for assembling a `SimpleContainer`
`IContainerBuilder` | Contract implemented by `ContainerBuilder`: `register`/`registerFactory`/`registerInstance`/`build`
`SimpleContainer` | In-memory container; `register`, `resolve`, `has`
`BaseContainerAdapter` | Extend to wrap an external DI framework as a vytches container
`IDependencyContainer` | Container public contract implemented by `SimpleContainer` and adapters
`IServiceLocator` | Contract implemented by `ServiceLocator` (see Patterns below)
`ServiceLocator` | Singleton global service locator with optional per-context containers; obtain via `getInstance()`
`VytchesDDD` | Static facade over `ServiceLocator.getInstance()` — configure/resolve/discover via static methods
`ServiceToken<T>` | Symbol/string/`Constructor<T>` identifier for a registration
`ServiceFactory<T>` | `(container) => T` factory function
`Constructor<T>` | `new (...args: unknown[]) => T` — shape used by `ServiceToken`, `HandlerInfo`, `implementation` params
`ServiceRegistrationOptions` | `{ lifetime?, context?, tags? }` — options param of `register`/`registerFactory`/`registerInstance`
`ServiceDescriptor<T>` | Return type of `IDependencyContainer.getServices()` / `getServicesByTag()`
`ResolutionContext` | Diagnostic record of an in-flight resolution: `token`, `resolutionChain`, `context`, `timestamp`
`ServiceLifetime` | `Transient`, `Singleton`, `Scoped`
`DIError` | Base error for container failures
`ServiceNotFoundError` | Thrown when `resolve(token)` finds no registration
`CircularDependencyError` | Thrown when factory chain re-enters itself
`ServiceAlreadyRegisteredError` | Thrown when registering a token that already exists in a given context
`InvalidRegistrationError` | Thrown when a registration call is malformed (e.g. bad token/implementation combination)
`ContainerConfigurationError` | Thrown by `ServiceLocator`/`VytchesDDD` when `configure()` was never called or given a null container
`ContainerDisposedError` | Thrown when a `ServiceLocator`/`VytchesDDD` method is called after `dispose()`
`HandlerDiscoveryRegistry` | Registry of `IHandlerDiscoveryPlugin`s used to auto-discover command/query/event handlers (see Patterns below)
`IHandlerDiscoveryRegistry` | Contract implemented by `HandlerDiscoveryRegistry`
`IHandlerDiscoveryPlugin` | Contract a consumer implements to plug a framework's handler scanning into discovery
`HandlerInfo` | `{ type, messageType, handlerType, metadata }` — element returned by handler discovery

section: Global service locator with context isolation
Anti-pattern: Do not use the global service locator inside aggregates or value objects
text:
**Do not use the global service locator inside aggregates or value objects** —
pass dependencies through constructor parameters. Service locator is for
application/infrastructure layer, not domain.

section: Anti-pattern: Do not register infrastructure adapters as Transient
text:
**Do not register infrastructure adapters as `Transient`** — DB clients,
loggers, and HTTP clients should be `Singleton`.

section: Anti-pattern: Do not import @vytches/ddd-di from a domain layer file
text:
**Do not import `@vytches/ddd-di` from a domain layer file** — domain packages
have no DI dependencies. DI lives at the composition root.

section: Anti-pattern: Do not forget VytchesDDD.reset() / ServiceLocator.getInstance().reset() between tests
text:
**Do not forget `VytchesDDD.reset()` / `ServiceLocator.getInstance().reset()`
between tests** — the service locator is a process-wide singleton, so state
configured in one test file leaks into the next unless explicitly reset.
